name: connection-pool-lab
description: Lab bài 02/03: Connection Pooling bằng PgBouncer (transaction mode) trước PostgreSQL 16 có max_connections nhỏ

scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d wallet -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v wallets=${WALLETS:-100000} < db/seed-wallets.sql
scripts.db:connections: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U postgres -d wallet -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < db/connection-stats.sql
scripts.db:pools: docker compose exec -T -e PGPASSWORD=pgbouncer_admin pgbouncer-a psql -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U pgbouncer_admin pgbouncer -c 'SHOW POOLS'
